# chargebee_attached_item (Resource)

Attaches a child item (addon or charge) to a parent plan item via Chargebee's Attached Items API, expressing plan→charge/addon relationships in Terraform. If the child item is already attached to the parent in Chargebee, the attachment is adopted into state and its mutable fields are updated to match this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "chargebee_attached_item" "standard_api_calls" {
  parent_item_id = chargebee_item.standard.id
  item_id        = chargebee_item.api_calls.id
  type           = "recommended"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) Id of the child item (addon or charge) to attach. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `parent_item_id` (String) Id of the parent plan item the child is attached to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `billing_cycles` (Number) Number of billing cycles the attached item is charged for.
- `charge_on_event` (String) Event that triggers the charge, e.g. `subscription_creation`. One of: `subscription_creation`, `subscription_trial_start`, `plan_activation`, `subscription_activation`, `contract_termination`, `on_demand`.
- `charge_once` (Boolean) Whether the charge is applied only once (rather than every billing cycle).
- `quantity` (Number) Default quantity of the attached item.
- `type` (String) How the attachment is offered: `recommended`, `mandatory`, or `optional`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Chargebee's identifier for the attachment.
